ordered_diagnoses: Cardiac Arrhythmia due to Pulmonary Disease

facts.raw_span: A man in his 80s without a prior history of arrhythmia
cough and shortness of breath during the COVID-19 pandemic
Cardiac auscultation: Regular rate and rhythm without murmurs, rubs, or gallops
Pulmonary auscultation: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs
Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min

cough and shortness of breath during the COVID-19 pandemic
Cardiac auscultation: Regular rate and rhythm without murmurs, rubs, or gallops
Pulmonary auscultation: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs
Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min

concepts.why: The patient developed palpitations and had a regular, narrow complex tachycardia with a rate of 170 beats/min on ECG.
The patient presented with cough and shortness of breath during the COVID-19 pandemic and had a positive SARS-CoV-2 PCR test.

concepts.preferred_label: Cardiac Arrhythmia due to Pulmonary Disease
concepts.why: The patient developed palpitations and had inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs, suggesting a link between the cardiac and pulmonary findings.

The patient had a regular, narrow complex tachycardia with a rate of 170 beats/min and mild diastolic dysfunction on echocardiogram, suggesting a possible link between the tachycardia and cardiac dysfunction.

rationales.F02: Cough and shortness of breath are common symptoms of COVID-19 pneumonia.
rationales.F03: Palpitations can be a symptom of atrial tachycardia and cardiac arrhythmia due to pulmonary disease.
rationales.F06: Increased respiratory rate can be a sign of pulmonary disease.
rationales.F10: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs are a common finding in COVID-19 pneumonia and cardiac arrhythmia due to pulmonary disease.
rationales.F11: Positive SARS-CoV-2 PCR test is a strong indicator of COVID-19 pneumonia.
rationales.F12: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with a rate of 170 beats/min is a characteristic ECG finding of atrial tachycardia.

frontier_selector.rationale: The patient's ECG findings, including regular, narrow complex tachycardia with a rate of 170 beats/min and superiorly directed P waves, are consistent with atrial tachycardia, which explains the palpitations.
